title: Sequenced rollout & release-notes orchestration for Console cost & rollout dashboards with field training
creator: Maya Singh
description: This ticket coordinates a phased launch for two Console UX features: (1) a cost breakdown explorer that surfaces token/route/model-level spend and (2) rollout controls for staged activations. The goal is a sequenced rollout across cohorts (internal beta, pilot customers, gradual public activation), tightly-coupled release notes, and a two-tier training plan for frontline teams and customer-facing engineers. Deliverables: final release notes artifact, comms schedule, training collateral, escalation runbook, and post-launch measurement dashboard.
tasks: Finalize release-notes draft and targeted snippets for Admin, Engineer, and Billing personas
Lock feature flag gating matrix and cohort definitions (internal beta, pilot, general availability)
Coordinate with ENG on rollback hooks and telemetry for rollout windows
Prepare training deck + 30-min demo video for Sales/SEs and a 60-min deep-dive for Support/Onboarding
Publish release notes to docs and prepare in-product CTA copy for discovery
Create escalation runbook and postmortem template for any rollout incidents
Configure post-launch dashboards measuring adoption, latency regressions, cost anomalies
milestones: 2026-03-08: Cross-team review and sign-offs (Legal, Security, Support)
2026-03-20: Pilot cohort activation and field training week

training_plan: Tier 1 (Sales/SE): 30-minute recorded demo + 1-pager cheat sheet with talking points
Office hours: two 1-hour sessions during pilot week for customer-specific Q&A
Enablement assets: short GIFs for common tasks, knowledge base FAQ, step-by-step admin flows
comm_plan: Internal announcement (all-hands summary + dedicated #console-launch Slack channel)
Pilot outreach: targeted emails to selected customers with feature guide and opt-in instructions
External launch blog post and changelog entry timed with GA activation
Release notes variants: Admin, Developer, Finance-focused snippets for different channels
Sales enablement pack including objection handling and pricing impact summary
release_notes_outline: Headline: Overview of cost breakdown & rollout controls
What’s new: short bullets with screenshots and recommended admin actions
Why it matters: value props for Engineering, Finance, Product
How to get started: feature flag steps, cohort selection, links to docs
Known limitations: data latency windows, supported model sets
Rollback & support: instructions and SLAs for reporting issues
acceptance_criteria: Release notes approved by Legal and Security
Training materials uploaded to internal enablement and at least one live session delivered
Telemetry events (rollout.start, rollout.pause, cost.alert) instrumented and dashboards visible
Pilot cohort saw no >2% error-rate increase and no severe latency regressions
Rollback path validated in staging and runbook reviewed by on-call engineers
risks: Unexpected cost spikes in pilot customers if caching/batching profiles differ
Confusion across personas if release notes are not segmented clearly
Insufficient telemetry could delay root-cause analysis in case of regressions
Tight coordination window with Sales and Support may lead to missed enablement sessions
